messages:
Alex W: Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone status. Please post: what shipped, what slipped, and next steps by EOD. Ping owners and call out any blockers. cc @Priya K @Sam J

Priya K: Short summary from product side: Customer routing (M2) shipped last week (release notes updated). Dashboards for HQ metrics are delayed — blocked on infra retention + tracing work. I'll enumerate owners below.

Sam J: Eng update: model-routing M2 is live ✅. We discovered perf regressions on the large-batch path while validating batching changes; batching opt is slipping to next sprint. Owners: Sam (batching), Maya (runtime perf), Ryan (infra).

Maya L: Confirming — seeing latency spike during stress tests when KV cache evicts on seq_len > 1024. Root cause narrowed; hotfix in PR 3124, tests local pass. Need one reviewer and canary window.

Ryan C: Infra notes: retention + tracing hooks for the new rollout are ~70% done. Blocker: access to prod logs bucket (req #1122) to run coverage checks. Once access is granted we can validate metrics. Proposed deploy window Thu 10-12 PST.

Alex W: Action items summary: Sam -> open FR for batching fallback policy; Maya -> push hotfix PR and request canary; Ryan -> approve bucket access + confirm deploy window; Priya -> update OKR doc with shipped/slipped and risk. I'll ping in shiproom after canary.

Sam J: FR opened: #3130. Adds canary-level fallback to force single-batch mode for high-latency batches. ETA Mon for complete implementation.

Priya K: :thumbsup: I'll mark dashboards as slipped (infra dependency) and note customer risk for 3 enterprise accounts — CS follow-up needed.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy of model-routing M2 started at 1901503000. Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/canary/1901503000

Maya L: PR 3124: https://github.com/redwood/inference-runtime/pull/3124 — ready for review. Tests pass locally, requesting @Sam J to review and approve for canary.

Sam J: Reviewing now, left 3 tiny comments in the PR. If those are minor I'll merge and trigger canary rollout.

Priya K: Thanks everyone — please reply here when your item is done and I'll close the OKR loop. Will add a short note to the quarterly doc once confirmed.

Alex W: Looping back: if canary looks good, we prioritize batching fallback next sprint and include regression test in CI. Otherwise we keep the fallback on by default for the next release.

Maya L: Will post canary results in this thread when available.

Sam J: Noted — will follow up on FR and merge PR if green.

Priya K: Tagged internal OKR doc: https://docs.redwood.example/q2-okr — updating in 30m.

Alex W: Thanks all. Short and actionable — appreciate the quick sync.
